candidate_081.name: advisory adaptive governance under deterministic promotion authority
candidate_081.mechanism_hypothesis: Keep stochastic/LLM diagnosis and adaptation planning advisory, while a deterministic champion-challenger envelope retains final authority over promotion, rollback, tail-risk and clipping checks. Evaluate candidate surrogates on stream-conditioned evidence before replacement, and keep the incumbent serving whenever no challenger clears the gate.

primary_evidence.source: Doyeong Lim, Seungyoon Lee, In Cheol Bang, Validation-Gated Multi-Agent Governance for Online Adaptation of Thermal-Hydraulic Surrogate Models under Operating-Regime Shift, arXiv:2606.03321v1, 2026-06-02.
primary_evidence.matched_ladder: The study uses seven streaming modes on two held-out experimental thermal-hydraulic transient splits with three seeds per mode: Static, Rule-H, Shadow, Single-H, Single-Full, MA-H and MA-Full. All adaptive modes share the same deterministic safety envelope, so agent recommendations do not gain authority by loosening promotion rules.
primary_evidence.quantitative_result: Static gives channel-averaged MAE 7.06 +/- 3.51 and warning exceedance 56.8 +/- 45.4%. Deterministic Rule-H improves MAE to 6.54 +/- 3.30 and exceedance to 46.4 +/- 44.1%. MA-Full gives the best mean MAE 5.72 +/- 2.39 and exceedance 35.8 +/- 31.5%, a 19.0% mean-MAE gain versus Static and about 12.5% lower MAE than Rule-H. Single-H, Single-Full and MA-H are intermediate at 6.24, 6.39 and 6.34 mean MAE, respectively.
primary_evidence.promotion_behavior: In a representative heat-pipe split, gated validation promoted temporal-FNO to Transformer as validation MAE changed 8.60 -> 5.64, then Transformer to GNN at 4.74 -> 3.16. Across MA-Full runs, 13 validated champion transitions were logged (8 to GNN-family, 5 to Transformer-family). Mean-error improvement alone was insufficient: promotion also required no regression in warning exceedance, tail risk or clipping, and rollback remained available for non-finite or excessively clipped predictions.
primary_evidence.statistical_scope: Paired bootstrap intervals for MA-Full versus Static excluded zero for MAE and exceedance, but intervals among adaptive modes overlapped and there are only six paired units. Therefore the paper supports deterministic-gated adaptive model evolution and a positive MA-Full-versus-Static result, but does not establish a definitive ranking or causal superiority of multi-agent governance over Rule-H/Single-H/MA-H.
primary_evidence.domain_scope: The stream uses experimental thermal-hydraulic facility data, but the comparison is replay/streaming evaluation on held-out transients rather than a randomized live-laboratory intervention trial. It therefore advances candidate_079's validation-gated arbitration frontier without closing the live-lab ablation request.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: This is direct evidence for separating agentic diagnosis/planning from machine-checkable promotion authority. It also shows that deterministic gates alone matter (Rule-H improves over Static), while agent-guided candidate prioritization can improve means further under the same envelope without granting agents deployment authority.

candidate_082.name: low-bandwidth validation feedback plus fresh-reproducer certificate
candidate_082.mechanism_hypothesis: When a research controller must query the same validation channel repeatedly, restrict feedback bandwidth (for example improved/not-improved rather than full scores) and periodically require a fresh isolated reproducer to recover the strategy from a compressed description without access to the original validation transcript. Treat failure to reproduce as a validation-exploitation warning rather than durable progress.

primary_evidence.source: Martin Andres Bertran, Aaron Roth, Zhiwei Steven Wu, What Fits (Into Few Tokens) Doesn't Overfit: Compression and Generalization in ML Research Agents, arXiv:2606.11045v1, 2026-06-09.
primary_evidence.input_compression: Across eight ML datasets, explorer agents receiving only a one-bit ladder signal indicating whether each candidate improves on the running best reach performance comparable to or better than agents receiving full numerical validation scores. This provides a concrete low-capacity feedback channel for repeated adaptive model selection.
primary_evidence.output_compression: Fresh reproducer agents are reset and receive training data plus only a short compressed strategy prompt, with no explorer code, transcript or validation set. 32-token prompts largely reproduce explorer performance; the paper's central claim is that successful strategies occupy a low-description-length region rather than depending on detailed validation-specific information.
primary_evidence.overfit_stress_test: Under deliberately aggressive validation exploitation, compression stops reproducing the inflated validation gains. Using the paper's 10% validation-holdout overfit rule and 5% validation-reproducer gap rule, a 128-token reproduction certificate flags all 38 labelled overfitting checkpoints and 6 of 64 remaining checkpoints (100% sensitivity, 91% specificity in that stress test).
primary_evidence.scope: This is ML-research-agent evidence, not autonomous physical science. The certificate assumes validation information reaches the reproducer only through the controlled message and does not solve pretraining contamination or external side channels. The result therefore motivates a validation-quarantine layer for candidate_079 rather than proving that binary feedback is optimal in scientific laboratories.
primary_evidence.control_relevance: Candidate_079 repeatedly reuses a validation channel to choose among surrogates. candidate_082 supplies a concrete stress-test/control: preserve an untouched final evaluation channel, reduce adaptive validation bandwidth where possible, and periodically test whether the selected strategy survives reset-and-reproduction without the adaptive transcript.

candidate_079_update.detail: The thermal-hydraulic seven-mode ladder gives direct same-safety-envelope evidence that deterministic gating already improves over Static and that MA-Full achieves the best mean under regime shift, while overlapping adaptive-mode intervals prevent a definitive agent-governance ranking. Separately, arXiv:2606.11045 gives a concrete repeated-validation control via one-bit feedback and fresh-reproducer compression tests. Still open: randomized live-lab fixed/scheduled-versus-validation-gated arbitration and a direct test that candidate_082-style validation quarantine preserves scientific discovery yield.
